Review Hevy?

Reviewers mostly see Hevy as a simple, well-designed workout logger that is fast to use between sets and strong at tracking progress over time. People repeatedly praise its clean interface, easy routine setup, customization, graphs, benchmarks, and social features that add motivation through friends, sharing, and light competition. A few users want a better UI, more advanced programs, stronger notifications or motivation prompts, a calendar, and richer stats, while some say sharing and weight tracking can be confusing or limited.

Hevy is a great fitness app for tracking workouts. It's easy to use, with an intuitive interface that allows you to quickly log exercises, weights, sets, and reps. The ability to create custom workouts makes it a valuable tool for staying on track with your fitness routine. I highly recommend Hevy to anyone looking for a reliable and user-friendly fitness app that can help them stay motivated and focused on achieving their fitness goals.
